results.answer: Yes. Work-Study Scholarship (근로 장학금) — eligibility: ‘대학 운영에 일정기간의 근로를 제공한 자’ (students who worked for the college for a set period); benefit: half of that semester's tuition (‘해당학기 교육비의 반액 지급’); note: previous-semester GPA 3.0 or higher (‘직전학기 성적 3.0이상’). [1]

results.question: Do new students get the grade-based scholarship in their first semester?
results.answer:
No. For the Academic Excellence Scholarship (성적우수 장학금) row ‘직전학기 학과별 성적우수자 학급당 1명’ (one top student per class, by previous-semester grades in each department), the table says 신입생 (new students) are eligible from semester 2 (benefit: full tuition waiver for 1 semester (‘1개학기 교육비 전액면제’); note: previous-semester GPA 3.0 or higher; for new students it applies from the 2nd semester (‘직전학기 성적 3.0이상 신입생은 2학기부터 적용’)). [1]
The separate Academic Excellence Scholarship (성적우수 장학금) row ‘학과수석 입학자 1명’ (the one top-ranked admitted student in each department) gives full tuition waiver for 1 year (‘1년간 교육비 전액면제’) (note: previous-semester GPA 3.0 or higher (‘직전학기 성적 3.0이상’)). [2]
